name: routine-row
title: Routine Row
description: One routine in a list: name and schedule, the next runs, owner and destination, the last run, Run now and a ⋯ with Skip next and Pause or Resume.

meta.whenToUse: A list of an agent's or a person's routines.
meta.whenNotToUse: A one-off scheduled run (a task with a due date), or a trigger's settings (SettingsRow).
